identity.name: E1
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix architectural precision with digital fluidity.
Emotion First: Evoke a sense of control and accuracy.
Content is King: Data and units are the heroes.
Zoom In: Focus on the pixel-perfect details.
Negative Space: Don't clutter the view; the grid needs to breathe.

headings.usage: Headings, Data Displays, Unit Labels, Coordinates

OverlayDock.description: The floating control panel for the electron app.

GridCanvas.style: Pointer-events-none (unless measuring). Canvas-based rendering for performance.

MonitorSelector.style: Miniature rectangles representing aspect ratios. Active state highlights the selected screen.

RulerTool.style: Click and drag to measure. Shows pixel/unit distance in a tooltip.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Update 'tailwind.config.js' and 'index.css' to match the 'Performance Pro' color palette. Force Dark Mode.
3. FONTS: Import 'JetBrains Mono' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in 'index.css'.
4. WEB APP: Build the Landing Page first. Use the 'Hero' image as a subtle background with a heavy dark overlay.
5. ELECTRON: The 'Overlay' component must be transparent. Use 'rgba(0,0,0,0)' for the body background in the overlay window.
6. STATE: Use a global store (Zustand or Context) to manage Grid Settings (spacing, color, thickness) so the Preview on Web and the Actual Overlay in Electron share logic.
7. MEASUREMENT: Implement the 'Ruler' logic using mouse coordinates. It must snap to the grid if 'Snap' is enabled.
8. TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all inputs in the Dock and Configuration panel.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic gradients, no centered text blocks without purpose.
Dark Mode Only: This is a pro tool. Do not build a light mode unless forced.
Micro-interactions: Buttons should glow on hover. Sliders should feel weighty.
Accessibility: Ensure high contrast for text (Gray-300 on Black, not Gray-600).
Code Quality: Use functional components, named exports for components, default exports for pages.
